checks.observation: Fibre masses (0,15,13,0,12,0,15,13) give order68, adjacent masses (12,27,28,28,28,28,28,25), triangle-freeness, minimum actual degree25 and independence number28. Fibres0,3,5 are empty. This concretely falsifies a positivity claim with cap28, consistent with the symbolic lower bound136-5h becoming-4. findings.disposition: This confirms the necessity of the imported H27 value. The new manuscript paragraph and superseding source addendum disclose the unreconstructed historical-run provenance; local degree-case checks do not fill that gap. No counterexample to H27 itself is claimed.
